en: I just want to say first of all to receive.
zh: 首先我只想说，能够获得这个奖。

en: I just want to say first of all to receive this award from Alyssa who.
zh: 首先我想说，能从 Alyssa 手中接过这个奖。

en: you brought me so much happiness and everyone else so much happiness with your performances
zh: 你的表演带给了我很多快乐，也带给了所有人很多快乐。

en: and I was so inspired by how much diligence and and work
zh: 而且你对待自己事业所投入的那份勤奋、努力，真的让我深受触动。

en: and effort and and love you have for what you do and
zh: 你对自己所做的事情投入了那么多努力，也倾注了那么多热爱。

en: and to be receiving artist of the year which is I love being an artist.
zh: 而现在能够获得“年度艺人”这个奖项——我真的很爱做一名创作者。

en: I love writing songs.
zh: 我热爱写歌。

en: more than anything in the world and.
zh: 这几乎是这个世界上我最爱的事。

en: I didn't think I was an artist when I first started doing it.
zh: 刚开始做这件事的时候，我并不觉得自己算是一名艺术家。

en: it was a hobby it was a hobby and then it was my favorite hobby
zh: 那时候它只是一个爱好，只是一个爱好，后来它变成了我最喜欢的爱好。

en: and then it was what I would like rush home from school to do.
zh: 再后来，它变成了我放学以后会迫不及待冲回家去做的事。

en: It's like I can't wait to get back to my guitar in my room
zh: 那种感觉就像是：我等不及要回到房间里，拿起我的吉他。

en: and write a song.
zh: 然后写一首歌。

en: and I just want to say like when I was 12 years old I had the luxury.
zh: 我还想说的是，在我12岁的时候，我其实很幸运。

en: of spending thousands of hours working at my craft.
zh: 我能花成千上万小时去打磨自己的技艺。

en: practicing making mistakes through trial and error.
zh: 练习、犯错，然后在一次次试错中成长。

en: and and that was all unobserved right.
zh: 而且那一切，都是在没有被人围观的情况下完成的，对吧。

en: so that was just me and my craft and I just I'm looking out into this crowd
zh: 那时候只有我和我的创作。而现在我看着台下的大家。

en: and I'm seeing so many ambitious cool smart awesome people who have dreams.
zh: 我看到这么多有野心、很酷、聪明又优秀的人，他们都有自己的梦想。

en: and like we we live in this world where there's so much immediate feedback constantly.
zh: 而我们生活在这样一个世界里：到处都是即时反馈，而且是持续不断的。

en: like you get feedback for everything you share with the world now.
zh: 现在你分享给世界的每一样东西，几乎都会立刻收到反馈。

en: like everything you post you feedback whether it's good or bad or whatever.
zh: 你发出的每一条内容，都会收到反馈，不管是好的还是坏的，或者别的什么。

en: I just want to say if I had if I had one hope for you I would say
zh: 所以我只想说，如果我可以送给你们一个祝愿，我会说。

en: that I hope that you get to nurture your hobby and your passion.
zh: 我希望你能好好守护自己的爱好和热情。

en: just between you and that craft and you give yourself time give yourself time to make mistakes.
zh: 让它先只存在于你和那门技艺之间，也给自己一点时间，给自己时间去犯错。

en: give yourself time to hone your craft.
zh: 给自己时间去不断磨炼自己的本事。

en: I'm a firm believer that anything you feed your mind it will internalize.
zh: 我始终坚信，你持续喂给自己大脑的东西，它最终都会被内化。

en: anything you feed the internet it will attempt to kill and I don't want that for your dreams.
zh: 而你喂给互联网的东西，它往往会试图把它扼杀掉——我不希望这样的事发生在你们的梦想身上。

en: so just thank you for allowing me to turn my hobby into a love into a passion into a dream into a career thank you for allowing me to have it this long
zh: 所以，真的谢谢你们，让我能把一个爱好，变成热爱，变成激情，变成梦想，变成事业；谢谢你们，让我能拥有这一切这么久。

en: and I wish you the best with everything you do.
zh: 也祝福你们做的每一件事都顺顺利利。

en: thank you so much for this amazing amazing night
zh: 非常感谢你们，给了我这样一个无比美好的夜晚。
